All nodes have a thermal storage term except for the refrigerant nodes, which can change temperature effectively instantaneously with changes in pressure. The enthalpy and temperature of each node is calculated with numerical integration using the explicit Euler approach. The dashed boxes indicate the boundaries of the nodes and all yellow arrows show energy flows in and out of the control volumes. The equations show the energy balance for each type of node.
